description: ADCOS Adapter object: a typed implementation boundary around a physical/logical access technology. Required properties encode the frozen MUST-expose list of spec/architecture.md §6.3. The adapter is authoritative only for the state of the technology it controls, never for ADCOS-wide state (LOCK-016, LOCK-017). Adapter runtime behavior is owned by WORK-016.

access_technology_id.description: Access technology/profile identifier; a registered entry of the access-profile registry, or a well-formed unknown future identifier (which consumers must preserve, not coerce).

adapter_id.description: Adapter instance identifier; distinct from NodeID (WORK-016).

capabilities.description: Capability references exposed by this adapter (capability-registry identifiers or well-formed unknown future identifiers).

lifecycle_controls.description: Lifecycle control surface state (open/close/allocate/release semantics owned by WORK-016).

link_metrics.description: Link metrics reported by this adapter; measurement semantics owned by WORK-026.

resource_mapping.description: Mapping of technology-specific resources into the ADCOS resource model (WORK-008).

session_bearer_mapping.description: Mapping between ADCOS sessions and technology-specific bearers; generic term per architecture §25 rule 1.

supported_profile_versions.description: Profile versions of the access technology this adapter supports.

title: ADCOS Adapter
